question: What was the dominant source of income in the Vijaynagar Empire?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Land Revenue.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Vijayanagar Empire**, one of the most prosperous empires in the **history of South India**, heavily relied on agriculture, **making land revenue its primary source of income.**
 
• Due to its fertile lands and well-developed irrigation systems, the empire was able to produce an abundance of crops, which contributed significantly to its economy.
 
• **The administrative system of the Vijayanagar Empir**e was highly efficient in collecting taxes and revenues from the land, which were then used for the empire's development and expansion.
 
• Apart from land revenue, the Vijayanagar Empire also earned income through trade, but land revenue remained the cornerstone of its economic strength.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Mining
 While important, mining was not the dominant source of income but contributed to the empire's wealth through precious stones and metals.
 
 

 2) Industrial duty
 Industries and crafts flourished in the empire, yet their duties were not the primary income source compared to land revenue.
 
 

 4) Import duty
 Import duties from foreign trade were significant but secondary to the income generated from land revenue.
